original_task: Unsupervised video object-centric instance segmentation and within-video correspondence, not cross-video category discovery
model_inputs: Active MOViD configuration uses video only for Train; frozen DINOv2 patch features; GT segmentations are external validation metric targets. No category names or labels in inspected base forward
model_outputs: Per-frame slots, feature reconstruction and instance masks; video-reset Hungarian slot correspondence, not persistent anonymous category tokens
losses: Feature reconstruction MSE1.0 plus adjacent-frame normalized same-slot contrastive CE0.5; cycle weight0.0. Batch contrast negatives include different instances/videos, not category-labelled multi-positive structure
training_protocol: MOViD active config:4-frame chunks,15slots,128slot dimensions,100000steps,Adam0.0004; trainable projection/SlotAttention/decoder and frozen pretrained visual backbone. No training performed by this audit
online_or_offline: Offline self-supervised chunk fitting; recurrent matching at inference, resets predictor at each video
causal_or_noncausal: Inspected base config current-frame initialization and previous-slot Hungarian matching; entire video features initialized before scan. No future-append mutation test performed upstream, so no dense-causal certification. Later optional forward-flow branches are not the inspected default
active_forward_details: Per-frame local-neighbor cosine minus global-mean cosine saliency; hard greedy current-feature query seeds with similarity suppression; iterative SlotAttention; cosine Hungarian reorders current slots after grouping; MLP soft mask decoder
evaluation: Image/video ARI and mask best overlap/IoU with external segmentation; not fixed Known recognition, semantic Novel H or persistent category CT
what_to_borrow: Controlled hypothesis separating within-track instance correspondence from cross-video category compatibility; frozen Raw temporal consistency baseline before learned dynamics, no assertion that instance matching solves category memory
what_not_to_borrow: Treating within-video slot ID as semantic category; adjacent-instance negatives as category multi-positive supervision; video-reset memory as persistent categories; later repository extensions as original paper implementation; published instance scores as TAO semantic results
